definitions.explanation: doing something because there is no other choice, not because one wants to

examples.japanese: やむを{得|え}ず⟦{欠席|けっせき}した→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧。
やむを{得|え}ず⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やむを{得|え}ず⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
examples.english: It was unavoidably canceled due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧やむを{得|え}ず⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to budget constraints, we had to change the plan.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal expression indicating that something was done because there was no alternative, often implying reluctance or regret.
More formal than ⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧. Often used in written or business contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦やむを{得|え}ない→やむを得ない：07320_yamuwoenai⟧ - unavoidable (adjective form)
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧ - cannot be helped; reluctantly

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{止|や}む→止む：01153_yamu⟧ (to stop) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{得|え}ず, the classical negative of ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: roughly "unable to stop it." Sometimes written ⟦{止|や}む→止む：01153_yamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{得|え}ず or {已|や}むを{得|え}ず.

WATCH OUT:
{得|え} is read え here, not とく; this is one of the few places where ⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧'s classical negative ず survives in everyday Japanese.
